         ACETANILIDUM

       Antifebrinum


Depresses heart, respiration and blood pressure, lowers temperature.
      Cyanosis and collapse. Increased susceptibility to cold. Destroys red blood corpuscles;
      pallor.



Head.--  Enlarged sensation. Fainting. Moral depravity.



Eyes.--  Pallor of optic discs, contracted visual field and
      shrinking retinal vessel; mydriasis.



Heart.--  Weak, irregular, with blue mucous membranes,
      albuminuria, œdema of feet and ankles.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Antipyrin  .



Dose.--  Used as a sedative and antipyretic for various forms of
      headache and neuralgia in doses of one to three grains. For the homeopathic indications use
      the third potency.
